_comment: Characters a reference genuinely prints, per template. The audit subtracts these so the worklist shows only real defects. Adding an entry is a claim that the reference image shows that character in that place — check before adding.

guided-setup.why: Canny's own headings carry a party popper and a sparkle.

social-scheduler.why: Buffer renders a wave in the greeting tile, emoji as the four template-card marks, and a cupcake inside the quoted comment.

finance-overview.why: Copilot Money lets people pick an emoji per spending category, and the reference prints those in the category list, the recurring rows and the category chips.

creator-revenue.why: Whop's own promotion banner prints a money-mouth face after "social media" and a flexed arm after "flex your stats", and the to-do row carries a waving hand beside "Welcome 12 new users".

product-analytics.why: Mixpanel's sidebar prints a seedling before "Starter Board" — it is the board's own emoji, shown in the Pinned list and again in the Recents and boards rows.

wizards.why: Buffer's own onboarding prints a waving hand in the welcome line (ref 007) and a seedling in "Thanks for choosing Buffer" (ref 016). Reproducing those is the rule; they are the reference's text, not our icons.
